title: iberis ciliata subsp. balansae
intro: Iberis ciliata subsp. balansae, commonly known as Dwarf Candytuft, is a plant species within the Brassicaceae family, known for its small, white, fragrant flowers. It has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including the treatment of colds, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dwarf Candytuft include its ability to relieve coughs and reduce inflammation, making it a potential treatment for respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of Iberis ciliata subsp. balansae include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
